title: The Kummer boundary commutes with arbitrary scheme pullback
statement: Let f:X→Y be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let N be invertible on both X and Y. For any c∈H¹(Y,G_m), pulling back δ_N(c) to H²(X,μ_N) gives δ_N of the pulled-back c. The pullback maps are inverse image on etale sheaf cohomology followed by the canonical coefficient maps f⁻¹G_m→G_m and f⁻¹μ_N→μ_N [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], [def-sc-kummer-sequence].

source.place: Proof: Both defining components commute with base change, so the isomorphism does too; the Kummer description by the class of O(1).

proof.text: The canonical G_m pullback comparison commutes with multiplication by N. Its restriction to kernels is the canonical μ_N comparison, so these three arrows form a morphism from the pulled-back Kummer short exact sequence to the Kummer sequence on X.

Naturality of the connecting homomorphism, first under the exact inverse image functor and then under this morphism of short exact sequences, gives the asserted equality in degree two. This is precisely the complete existing proof of Scheme.rootsOfUnityCohomologyMap_kummerδ₁.

lemma rootsOfUnityCohomologyMap_kummerδ₁ (hY : IsUnit (n : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (hX : IsUnit (n : Γ(X, ⊤)))
    (c : Y.CohomologicalPicardGroup) :
    rootsOfUnityCohomologyMap g n 2 (Y.kummerδ₁ n hY c) =
      X.kummerδ₁ n hX (gmCohomologyMap g 1 c)
